title: NAOMI
description: NAOMI — the Native AI Operational Maturity Index: five pillars and five levels for working out what holds in an engineering organisation when nobody is watching, and therefore how much can safely be delegated.

lede.text: Five pillars, five levels. The level names what holds the promise — nobody, a person, the system, an instrumented system, or a system that improves its own hold. What you may safely delegate follows from that, and from nothing else.
lede.note: When production is cheap, the scarce resource is assurance.
